personality_one_liner: A premium, long-term digital career companion that feels exceptionally professional, trustworthy, and native to the OS.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Do not cramp content. Use 'md' or 'lg' between list items and inner card paddings.

do's: Upload FAB (Floating Action Button) in Passport tab
dont's: Do not use on regular data cards or form fields
Do not use on error or warning alerts

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: A 5-step flow capturing role, qualification, country, and goal.

states.loading: Subtle loading spinner overlaid on active state.
states.error: Standard alert toast using surfaceInverse if validation fails.

screens.layout: Full-width pagination. Bold display title at the top left. Large, touchable radio cards (flexWrap) for selection. Primary 'Next' CTA is sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Personalized dashboard highlighting professional status and quick links.

states.loading: Skeleton cards mimicking the status banner and grid.
states.empty: Prompt to 'Set up your Professional Passport' in the hero card.
states.error: Error loading status with a 'Tap to Retry' muted button.

screens.layout: A large 'Hero Card' at the top with a subtle gradient (brandPrimary to brand), displaying active licenses, BLS, and a circular CME progress indicator. Below it, a 2-column flex-wrap grid for quick menu items (Jobs, Languages, AI Nurse).

screens.name: Study
screens.purpose: Nursing Academy containing structured learning modules.
screens.layout: Top scrolling segmented control for categories (Year 1-4, Post Basic, Specialties). A vertical list of large cards for each Subject. Cards feature an abstract photo or tinted icon on the left, title, and a small horizontal progress bar.

screens.name: Exams
screens.purpose: Question Bank and Exam Center for global licensing.
screens.layout: Two top tabs: 'Question Bank' and 'Exam Center'. Question Bank uses a 2-col grid for 6 mode tiles (Practice, Timed, Mock, etc.). Exam Center uses a vertical list of countries (UAE, UK, USA) featuring flag thumbnails and brief exam descriptions.

screens.name: Abroad
screens.layout: A vertical roadmap (stepper) with nodes and connecting lines. Past steps are 'success' green, active step is 'brandPrimary', future steps are 'muted' gray. Sticky CTA at the bottom: 'Continue Pathway'.

screens.name: Passport
screens.purpose: Secure document vault with expiry alerts.

states.empty: Illustration of a safe/wallet. Text: 'Your vault is empty.' CTA: 'Upload Document'.

screens.layout: Wallet-style dashboard. Top section shows 'Alerts' horizontally for EXPIRING SOON (warning) or EXPIRED (error). Main section is a vertical list of documents grouped by category. Uses status badges on each row. A glass FAB at bottom right to add new.

world_map_abroad.alt: Blue world map for international pathways

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Note that the 'brand' color is deep navy as explicitly requested by the user, breaking the standard negative prompt rule for blue, due to specific user request.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for text; it provides a highly professional, readable experience, especially for medical data and exam numbers.
Maintain the iOS-Native Clean layout principles: generous paddings, clear visual hierarchy, soft md/lg radiuses on cards.
Ensure every screen has an empty, loading, and error state properly aligned (flex: 1).
In the 'Abroad' tab, implement a vertical stepper using flex-direction: column and border-left lines to simulate the roadmap (e.g., the 10-step Germany pathway).
In the 'Passport' tab, prominently display semantic status badges: 'ACTIVE' (success), 'EXPIRING SOON' (warning), 'EXPIRED' (error), and 'MISSING' (muted or outline).
Ensure the hero card in 'Home' utilizes a gradient from brand to brandPrimary and includes a circular progress indicator for CME.
